summary: The idempotency check and insert are not atomic, so concurrent retries can create duplicate payments.

findings.title: Concurrent requests can bypass the idempotency check
findings.evidence: find_by_request_id is executed separately from save, with no atomic repository operation shown between them.
findings.impact: Two requests with the same request_id can both observe no payment and persist separate records, causing duplicate payment creation.
findings.recommendation: Enforce a unique constraint on request_id and expose an atomic create-or-return-existing repository operation that handles the uniqueness conflict.
findings.regression_test: Start two create_payment calls for the same request_id at a barrier and assert that both return the same persisted payment and only one row exists.
